tips: | Not really an extreme threat, but the early game can be tough if you can't dodge her abilities. EDIT: With the recent Syndra changes, she does have more late game power. If you are able to dodge Qs and her stun in laning phase, you are CHILLING!
| Again, like syndra, it can be difficult if Orianna lands everything. However, should be easier once you hit level 6.
| Uhh, good luck for this. He'll do 2x damage to you while being 3x as tanky. Focus on roaming and asking for jungler's help.
| Experience will be needed for this matchup. Gets harder as the game goes on. Just like any other tank matchups, if you don't get ahead early, it will be really hard.

| Lucian tends to go exhaust in this matchup. Hard to play if you get chunked early, so sit under turret and farm with qs. Once you are level 4, start looking for your combos. You can generally kill him at level 6 if you aren't behind in exp or health.
| Any immobile champs will be great for you. Easy all-in and have tons of kill pressure. Just don't get baited and get killed by their enemy jungler.
| If you aren't very fed, K'Sante will be nearly impossible to kill. However, once you have items like Black Cleaver, killing him becomes easier
| Since I play alot of Cassio, I generally know how to dodge her abilties. However, if you aren't able to dodge her Qs or R, this matchup can get very hard
| Generally pretty easy matchup if you don't get poked out early. Poke with your W+E+Q combo and back off when your W is on cooldown

| Honestly, depends on the elo. In higher elo, this matchup can be very hard due to the constant harass. Doran's shield start is honestly not a bad idea. In lower elo, I wouldn't worry about it too much

| ASol's laning phase is pretty weak. You are able to punish. However, once he reaches late game, it's not you won't be able to kill him. It's that he'll be 100% more useful in dragon/baron fights with his R
| Skill match-up. But Akali can be very annoying with her shroud and E. Be patient with your W usage
| If you have a Yummi on your team, it's won :D
| With Sejuani being picked quite often these days, Zed is great with Sej! The amount of CC that Sej provides is great for landing your combos!
| If Elise lands her stun, it's 100% a kill or a flash in the early game
| Very nice kill potential at level 6
| Very good synergy as Evelynn loves being the sole AP and Zed is better off with an AP jungler
